decision_conditions:
DRAWING AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS:  The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

P-2428-000 Existing & Proposed Site Plan, Proposed Site Block Plan,
P-2428-103 A Proposed First Floor Plan, 
P-2428-104 A Proposed Second Floor Plan, 
P-2428-105 A Proposed Third Floor Plan (Lower Level),
P-2428-106 A Proposed Third Floor Plan (Upper Level),
P-2428-107 A Proposed Roof Plan,
P-2428-108 C Proposed Front Elevation & Proposed Rear Elevation,  
P-2428-110 A Proposed Side (north) Elevation, 
P-2428-113 C Proposed Section CC,
Sustainable Design & Construction Statement Sept 2026

REASON: To comply with Section 70(1)(a) of the Town and Country Act 1990 as amended and the Reason for Grant and also for the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
description: Removal/variation of condition 2 (drawings) of planning consent ref: P2025/0520/FUL dated 21/05/2025  for 'Proposed ground floor side return and rear extension, dormer extension to rear roof slope with rooflight, replacement tiled roof, replacement windows with double glazing, landscaping to rear garden including lowering garden level and extending boundary wall with relocation of gate' to raise boundary wall of side extension by 330mm to form gutter and remove UPVC eaves gutter.
